note: Requests may be satisfied by already running packages; do not create duplicate work. Methods runs no subagents and does not poll other folders.

requests.question: Provide exact SHA for author/corrected network replay, including shared pair capture, unit conversions, all selected legs and delta.
requests.acceptance: Preserved author outputs; numerical replay tolerances; common market budget during selection; per-itinerary seats and one fare; explicit frequency/resource envelope and route definition; corrected result not labelled market-validated.
requests.dependency: Network package already assigned by root; methods first common run depends on it.

requests.question: Provide exact SHA for cost/kover package and provenance of rates, donor/own-migration accounting, fixed costs and cash timing.
requests.acceptance: No-kover baseline unchanged; tax/price/unit and valid dates explicit; event-day counts not downtime; no double-counted donor margin; UNKNOWN budgets preserved; removal of kover leaves other risks.
requests.dependency: Cost/operating package; does not block arithmetic threshold work by methods.

requests.question: Provide completed join/source package with exact SHA, especially endpoint versus segment grain and competitor coverage for tested OD.
requests.acceptance: Source keys/time/unit/coverage preserved; airport totals not renamed OD; absent snapshot not zero competition; marketing duplicates and via-stops separated; unresolved arrivals/units remain NULL.
requests.dependency: Data join package; no need for methods to poll source folders.

requests.question: When ready, provide exact SHA of new useful product/evidence experiments and their impact on a named scenario parameter or constraint.
requests.acceptance: Candidate, product, period, counterfactual, refusal criterion, cost/resource effect; no inferred sales or financial-model equivalence. Preserve inconclusive and rejected cases.
requests.dependency: Parallel hypothesis work; not a gate to publishing current comparison.

inputs: methods first published SHA to be supplied in handoff
requests.question: Independently review methodology and numerical examples, especially capture law versus confirmed error, donor double count, cash versus accrual and route units.
requests.acceptance: New independent review on exact package; replicate at least shared MOW-OMS, Tsiri itinerary/ledger and C01 threshold; counterexamples for mixed products/shared capacity; actionable P1/P2 with exact evidence and acceptance limits.
requests.dependency: Publication of first methods package; root chooses timing within shared Sol pool.

requests.question: Check whether inherited block_method metadata correctly describes RouteModel.block for each profile; retain original and corrected metadata separately if mismatched.
requests.acceptance: Per-leg value and provenance must be distinguished; do not change actual flight-time numbers only to match a stale description.
requests.dependency: Can be included in existing network audit; no separate agent needed.
